reference41r.decision: Stop serial41 repairs; advance under explicit accepted limitations, not retroactive qualification.
conditions: Keep teacher/formula and frozen41r controls paired.
Validate passive/axial reference floors, units and balances before interpreting active transfer.
Separate inherited local failures, new failures and coupling amplification by case identity.
No privileged teacher corrections online, hidden refit, new solver or abstraction change.
Keep original quality gates and full failure reporting; no aggregate cancellation of regressions.
No general ELM superiority, teacher equivalence or integrated speedup claim.
Reopen41 repairs only for a concrete downstream blocker or genuinely new discriminating hypothesis.
reference41r.speed_scope: Historical~8x isolated resident ionic core; current integrated benchmark not a qualified speedup.

quality.normalization: For each trajectory/channel S=max(max_t abs(I_reference),1e-7 mA/cm2). Charge errors divided by duration*S, not near-zero signed target charge. Report absolute errors and peak-relative charge diagnostics as well. No averaging across regimes to waive a failed critical gate.
quality.event_support: Transient timing evaluated only when reference peak-baseline contrast >=25% of S, peak >=10*floor, and peak is internal to the window. Other cases explicitly not_evaluable; amplitude/current gates still apply. Onset/offset use 10% of reference transient amplitude. Multi-event morphology needs dedicated matching in closed-loop stage.

reason.previous_assistant_statement: Residual gate index3 was described as NaTs2_t.h.
reason.correct: Index3 is Ca_LVAst.h; NaTs2_t.h is index7.
reason.why: Verified source STATE_NAMES/OFFSETS and per-gate trace errors. This corrects interpretation only, not measured metrics or gates.

hypotheses.claim: Global Nap_h rate rollback breaks a learned equilibrium/rate compensation on nominal histories.
hypotheses.test: Nap2x2: rate-only versus joint equilibrium/rate, crossed with functional preservation guard off/on. All start f011, not the old baseline.
hypotheses.discriminator: If joint+guard preserves old pass identities while rescuing negative-tail gate memory, compensation/preservation is supported; low coefficient RMSE alone does not count.

hypotheses.claim: Frozen-feature conditioning or inadequate rare-history coverage, not missing memory state, limits the repair.
hypotheses.test: One common nominal+negative-tail FIT pool; same frozen-feature least-squares diagnostic and1/4 nonlinear refinements. Probe coefficient, free recurrence and functional losses separately.
hypotheses.discriminator: Compare ideal FIT projection, actual quantized forward and cross-history DEV. Do not infer that more data/steps necessarily cures a failed readout space.

hypotheses.claim: A tiny equilibrium/rate bias amplified at a flat crossing explains the remaining Ih offset.
hypotheses.test: Ih coefficient-only versus crossing-aware joint-readout refinement, same FIT support. Observe the actual intermediate node1 as well as root/distal; probe inf-only/rate-only oracles diagnostically.
hypotheses.discriminator: Reduced actual signed onset/offset under original event evaluator, with correct current amplitude and no new pass-case failures. DeltaI/slope alone is not a success criterion.

hypotheses.claim: Ca_LVAst.h kinetic-map extrapolation causes the hidden-state failures near -130mV.
hypotheses.test: Ca_LVAst.h rate-only versus joint equilibrium/rate readout fits on nominal+tail FIT; inf/rate2x2 oracles and teacher-reset/free recurrence first. Identify real owning module through Swap mask, not hardcoded parent.
hypotheses.discriminator: A kinetic oracle must explain the gate error before attributing it to optimization. Preserve Ca current, calcium feedback and nominal Ca_LVAst gating.

hypotheses.claim: NaTs2_t.h is the dominant failed hidden gate in the six45b safe-panel cases.
hypotheses.test: Probe channel/state IDs for both Ca_LVAst.h(index3) and NaTs2_t.h(index7) on all six failures; NaTs2_t.h stays frozen as negative attribution control unless new evidence says otherwise.
hypotheses.discriminator: 45b actual18-state traces contradict this claim: dominant index3, not7. No unnecessary NaTs2_t.h training based on a naming mistake.

hypotheses.claim: Repairs selected independently on DEV compose without new coupled feedback or inherited-pass regressions.
hypotheses.test: Combine pre-frozen DEV-selected Nap/Ih/Ca_LVAst repairs and compare with each component under identical imposed/autonomous, coupling and prefix cases.
hypotheses.discriminator: Combined arm must retain the union of acquired pass identities, not only improve an aggregate average. Distinguish inherited f011 failures from new composition failures.

DEV-frozen best nonregressing component of each family, no coupled-outcome selection

fixed_structure: Same18explicit gate states, recurrence map, current algebra, calcium and axial solver. Only existing relevant kinetic readout weights/biases can change; trunk, all other heads and NaTs2_t.h frozen. No online oracle, new basis, V-dependent head switching or altered precision policy.
phase_order: Verify f011 byte/logical hashes and gate-index ownership; CPU/GPU materialization parity before scientific evaluation.
Diagnostic coefficient/oracle probes on opened45b paths, including intermediate Ih-failed node. No new fitted weights during this phase.

DEV no-regression nomination and weight hashes; combine selected components only after this freeze.

fitting_design.budget_unit: nonlinear frozen-feature refinement, not SGD steps
fitting_design.candidate_solver: FIT-only whitened regularized least-squares/Gauss-Newton in existing head space; coefficients plus exact causal gate/current sensitivities. Actual FP32 materialized models checked at each checkpoint.
fitting_design.preservation: Guarded Nap arms preserve functional responses, event crossings and hidden-state accuracy on nominal FIT histories against the teacher; a separate bounded f011 imitation term may preserve existing compensation. Guard acceptance is tested case-by-case on DEV with original gates, not assumed from loss.
fitting_design.saturation: Exact0/1 coefficient labels are censored and counts reported; evaluator probabilities/states are never clipped to hide failure.

nomination: Highest DEV all-prefix joint pass count, no new failure on any f011-passing DEV case, then smallest worst original-gate severity, then earlier checkpoint/registered arm order. Baseline fallback if no eligible repair. No old stress or coupled-audit outcomes used to select weights. Report all candidates including rejected ones.
metrics: Original current nRMSE/nmax/signed and absolute charge/onset/offset/peak criteria.
Per-gate RMSE/max/occupancy with channel+state names, not only pooled V or current.
Original V/Ca/native-floor/physical-domain criteria at every100/500/1000ms prefix.
Case-identity regression maps, event support and signed crossing shifts; intermediate-node slope/baseline diagnostics.
Parameter count and resident ionic/integrated execution costs separately; no speedup claim from batching overhead alone.

source_transport.rationale: Conservative alternative to denied local archive upload: read existing user-owned45b persisted output within Kaggle. No native payload exported from local machine. CPU mounted preflight mandatory.

limits: Exploratory45c, not independent47 or qualified release.
No thresholds, state representation, inference equations or abstraction changes.
Fresh DEV labels only nominate targeted repairs; all-model coupled and historical regressions can still reject them.
Original single-transient evaluator unchanged; signed/slope probes diagnostic only.
execution_authority: User explicitly authorized notebook implementation, DB registration, Git push and one Kaggle run; local-only DB backup.

cost.scope: Original resident single-compartment ionic/integrated CUDA Graph benchmark, all materialized candidates; formula32/formula64 and H controls. Separate from13-arm coupled evaluator overhead; no automatic speed qualification.

calibration.rule: Native-only disconnected root chain4, same conditioning and40:200ms pulse. Bisect for target minimum over whole1000ms. Keep safe side (minimum >=target). Freeze resulting three current densities, COMMON to every geometry and coupling. Do not inspect candidate results before freeze. Other geometries retain explicit physical-domain checks.

fitting.precision: FP64 NumPy causal sensitivity/linear solves; frozen FP32 quantized features/logits. Check actual FP32 materialized forward on DEV at checkpoints1/4. No optimizer state sharing or hidden resets.
fitting.objective: Equal macro-normalized coefficient rows plus selected path rows. N00/N10 coefficient-only; N01/N11 add nominal teacher gate/current preservation and bounded f011-current imitation on nominal FIT histories. I0 coefficient-only; I1 adds original10%-transient crossing-neighbor current rows. L0/L1 add gate and current path rows on all FIT histories. Same data and unchanged evaluator.
fitting.sensitivities: Exact causal recurrence Jacobian for existing h/u/z readout heads on imposed FIT paths, with frozen other gates. Regularized whitened Gauss-Newton, independent seed solves, step norm cap2. No new features, layers or runtime coefficient formulas.
fitting.nominal_guard: Teacher-current/gate FIT rows, not a promise of no regressions. Actual all-channel previously-passing DEV identities must remain passed; reject candidates introducing any new DEV failure.
fitting.nomination: For each family: candidates with no new all-channel/prefix failure vs C0 on fresh DEV. Rank highest all-prefix TARGET current+gate pass count, then smallest target worst normalized severity, earlier checkpoint/registered order. C0 fallback. Freeze component choices before coupled audits. J combines only these frozen heads. Report whole-model DEV outcomes as well; target acquisition never presented as a global pass.

implementation_scope: New fixed-V/Ca histories are synthetic FIT/DEV only. Opened45b native/calibration fixtures reused verbatim, checksummed. No native regeneration, no Task47 data. Native reference floors and physical-domain checks still required for interpreting all coupled results.
regression_guards: C0 must exactly reconstruct f011 logical hash; six41r failures and FP32 controls218/234 remain explicit.
No NaTs2_t.h weight changes; its index7 is probed as attribution control, Ca_LVAst.h is index3.
Report all100/500/1000ms prefixes; no averaging away intermediate failures.
Old original45 invalid physical regimes stay diagnostic, never counted as model passes.
All13 arms evaluated at identical arm/case/seed batch shape; all-formula null control and packed/materialized parity mandatory.
41 stress and44 regressions are opened audits after nomination, never selection input.
persistence: Persist source/member checks, fitted checkpoints and nomination before coupled phase; results per geometry/mode. Native source cache excluded from final ZIP. Full metrics plus V/Ca and target gate3/7/9/10/current1/4/5 for all arms; full18/11 tensors for C0/J. Partial/final ZIP on failure/success, Kaggle persisted output and local SHA/CRC readback. DB local2 verified bundles.
runtime_budget: One private T4 run, worker5400seconds, outer7200seconds. No automatic relaunch on failure. FIT/DEV Jacobian solves on CPU avoid long-BPTT overhead; CUDA resident comparisons and shared seed/arm batches. Eager execution timings descriptive, no speedup claim.
